description: [Free] What something will cost, spending nothing: one generation (kind clip or image, optional model, duration_s, resolution, role, count), or a video_id's next rerender_video (render plus every AI visual not yet made). A length between two a model makes is rounded UP, with a warning; one it cannot make is refused with what it can. plan_note says when this plan has no AI generation.

duration_s.description: Clip length in seconds, within the model's range.

kind.description: Price one generation of this kind.

model.description: A model id from list_models. Omit for the house model.

resolution.description: Clip resolution, one the model offers.

role.description: A full-frame scene or a presenter in a corner (a presenter uses the cheapest resolution).

video_id.description: Price the next rerender_video of this video.

name: quote_cost
title: Quote a cost before spending
